title: Constant integral scalar restriction and tower-valued point sections
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the completed coefficient sheaf $R_W$ and the canonical constant-to-completion map [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the lifted ring $\widetilde R$ of [def-coef-tower-trace-constructions]. Define $\mathrm{coefTraceScalar}$ to be the ring homomorphism $\widetilde R\to R_W(W)$ obtained from constant sections and that canonical map. Define $\mathrm{coefTraceConstantScalars}$ to send an $R_W$-module sheaf to its underlying sheaf of $\widetilde R$-modules using the final-object action and this homomorphism. Define $\mathrm{coefTraceSheafTowers}(W)=\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Sh}(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\operatorname{Mod}_{\widetilde R})$. For the actual quotient sequence module category and its completed-scalar restriction [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], define $\mathrm{coefTraceSystemRestriction}$ by that restriction followed by $\mathrm{coefTraceConstantScalars}$ at every level. It retains each actual quotient-semilinear transition. Define $\mathrm{coefTraceSections}$ by evaluation at the final pro-etale object at every level, with target $\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Mod}_{\widetilde R}$; it takes no inverse limit.
